title: WorkSpec v2.1
description: Canonical WorkSpec v2.1 schema for modeled work, conditions, references, timed effects, schedule constraints, and reservations.

$schema.description: Reference to this JSON Schema for IDE autocomplete and validation. Recommended value: 'https://universalautomation.wiki/workspec/v2.1.schema.json'.

Simulation.description: Root container for a WorkSpec simulation (also referred to as: workflow, process).

schema_version.description: WorkSpec schema version using Major.Minor format. For this schema: '2.1'.

type_definitions.description: Optional custom type definitions. Keys are custom type names; values describe base type extension and additional properties.

state_libraries.description: Optional reusable semantic state sets and appearance-to-asset mappings. Library keys are referenced explicitly by objects.

type_traits.description: Optional reusable capability declarations for custom type systems.

day_types.description: Optional reusable day templates for repeating multi-period simulations.

displays.description: Optional display-interface surfaces authored in WorkSpec Studio.

title.description: Human-readable title (also referred to as: name, label).

description.description: Detailed description of what this simulation models (also referred to as: summary, overview).

domain.description: Industry/domain category (also referred to as: sector, category).

time_unit.description: Base unit for numeric duration values.

start_time.description: Simulation start time (HH:MM / HH:MM:SS or ISO 8601 date-time).

end_time.description: Simulation end time (HH:MM / HH:MM:SS or ISO 8601 date-time).

locale.description: BCP 47-style locale tag (for example en-US or zh-Hans-CN).

World.description: Static environment definition: layout and objects.

objects.description: All entities in the simulation (people, equipment, resources, products, services, digital objects).

digital_locations.description: Compatibility location for digital locations; prefer simulation.digital_space.digital_locations.

displays.description: Compatibility location for displays; prefer simulation.displays.

Process.description: Dynamic workflow definition: tasks and optional recipes.

Layout.description: Spatial configuration for the simulation world.

Location.description: A place/area where objects exist and tasks occur.

StandardObjectProperties.description: Documented properties shared by built-in object types. Domain-specific and custom-type properties are also allowed.

capacity.description: Numeric capacity or a domain-specific capacity string that includes units.

Object.description: An entity in the simulation (actor, equipment, resource, product, service, or digital object).

id.description: Object identifier (snake_case). May optionally be namespaced as '{type}:{id}'.

location.description: Location ID where the object is situated.

state_library.description: Optional explicit reference to a key in simulation.state_libraries. This is independent of the object's base type.

appearance.description: Optional appearance key within the referenced State Library.

StateLibrary.description: A reusable list of valid semantic states plus optional appearances that map those states to project asset IDs.

additionalProperties.description: Map of a declared state name to an uploaded project asset ID.

Task.description: A discrete step performed by an actor/equipment/service.

when.description: If false at the scheduled start, skip this task.

requires.description: Mandatory start precondition; false blocks the task.

Interaction.description: A task effect on an object. Either a property change, or an action (create/delete).

target_id.description: Object ID or an expression resolving to one.

temporary.description: If true, revert changes after the task completes.

at.description: Permanent effects default to completion. Temporary property changes always start and restore at completion.

PropertyChanges.description: Map of property name -> change operator.

ValueExpression.description: A JSON literal or a WorkSpec value reference. Reference-shaped literal objects use {literal: value}.

TimeOffset.description: A signed relative offset; zero is permitted.

DependsOn.description: Task dependencies, either an array (implicit AND), or an object with explicit all/any operators.

TaskStart.description: Task start time. Supports HH:MM, HH:MM:SS, ISO 8601 date-time, or {day,time}.

Duration.description: Positive task duration. Supports integer (uses config.time_unit), ISO 8601 duration (e.g., PT30M), or shorthand including decimals (e.g., 30m, 1.5h, 1d, 10s, 1w, 1M).

TimeOrDateTime.description: Either a strict time-of-day (HH:MM or HH:MM:SS, zero-padded) or an ISO 8601 date-time.

ObjectId.description: Object id, either plain snake_case or optional namespaced id '{type}:{identifier}'.

DateExpression.description: ISO calendar date or a relative date expression used by multi-period calendars.

MultiPeriodConfig.description: Optional overall date range for a repeating multi-period simulation.

Calendar.description: Repeating day-type pattern with optional date-specific overrides.

LegacyDayTypeInteraction.description: Compatibility form still understood by the multi-period Studio renderer; canonical task interactions should use property_changes.

DayType.description: Reusable definition of one operational day in a multi-period simulation.

DigitalSpace.description: Digital topology and data movement associated with the simulation.

Recipes.description: Recipe definitions keyed by product id.

Recipe.description: A recipe describing required inputs for a product.

TypeTrait.description: A reusable capability declaration for object types.

TypePropertyDefinition.description: Schema-like metadata for a custom object property.

TypeDefinition.description: Custom type definition extending a built-in base type.

additional_properties.description: Optional schema-like description of extra properties for this custom type.
